nodes.label: AutoResearchClaw: Multi-Agent Autonomous Research Pipeline
nodes.author: Jiaqi Liu, Shi Qiu, et al.
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent autonomous research system addressing hypothesis quality, execution robustness, and experience accumulation through five mechanisms: structured multi-agent debate, self-healing executor with Pivot/Refine loop, verifiable result reporting, human-in-the-loop collaboration, and cross-run evolution. Outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7% on ARC-Bench.

nodes.label: Structured Multi-Agent Debate
nodes.rationale: Assigns agents complementary epistemic roles (Innovator, Pragmatist, Contrarian for ML; Theorist, Phenomenologist, Experimentalist for HEP-ph) to stress-test hypotheses and conclusions. Synthesizer integrates outputs into structured artifacts. Applied at hypothesis generation and result analysis stages.

nodes.label: Self-Healing Executor with Pivot/Refine Loop
nodes.rationale: Treats experiment failures as diagnostic information rather than termination signals. Cascading code generation with complexity scoring routes experiments to external AI agent or multi-phase internal agent. Pivot/Refine decisions: Proceed (evidence supports hypothesis), Refine (weak results but sound direction), or Pivot (fundamentally flawed approach).

nodes.label: Verifiable Result Reporting
nodes.rationale: Numeric registry stores every value produced by experiment runs (per-condition means, standard deviations, individual seed measurements). Pre-built LATEX tables populated exclusively from registry injected into generation prompt. Post-hoc verifier re-extracts numeric claims and checks against registry; unverified claims in strict sections trigger document rejection.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Citation Verification Pipeline
nodes.rationale: DOI resolution via CrossRef, fuzzy title matching against OpenAlex, arXiv identifier lookup, Semantic Scholar fallback. LLM-based relevance check classifies references as Verified, Suspicious, or Hallucinated. Hallucinated references removed before draft finalization.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration with Seven Intervention Modes
nodes.rationale: Seven intervention modes: Full-Auto (no input), Gate-Only (3 fixed checkpoints), Thorough (all phase boundaries), CoPilot (6 high-leverage points), Step-by-Step (every stage), Pre-Experiment (early-pipeline), Post-Experiment (late-pipeline). CoPilot achieves 87.5% accept rate vs. Full-Auto's 25% and Step-by-Step's 50%.

nodes.label: Cross-Run Evolution with Time-Decayed Lesson Store
nodes.rationale: Persistent lesson store converts past failures into reusable safeguards. Lessons ranked by time-decayed weight w(l) = s(l) · exp(-ln(2) · Δt / T_1/2) where T_1/2 = 30 days default. Recent failures strongly constrain subsequent runs; older lessons gradually fade. Injected as natural-language overlays requiring no model retraining.

nodes.label: ARC-Bench: 25-Topic ML + 20-Topic Scientific Domain Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Benchmark spanning tabular ML, optimization, dimensionality reduction, NLP, AutoML, GP kernels, topic modeling, semi-supervised learning, dynamical systems, anomaly detection, feature selection, causal discovery, learning-to-rank, plus 10 HEP physics, 7 systems biology, 3 statistics tasks. Supports experiment-stage, end-to-end, and scientific-domain evaluation modes.

nodes.label: Rubric-Assisted Strict Judge for Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Grades along three dimensions: Code Development (CD, 25%), Code Execution (CE, 25%), Result Analysis (RA, 50%). RA receives double weight to capture scientific reasoning quality. Two independent agent reviewers run in parallel; disagreements exceeding |Δ| > 0.20 re-adjudicated. Mean per-leaf |Δ| < 0.10 across audited subset.

nodes.label: Autonomous Research Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: 23-stage pipeline across three phases (Discovery, Experimentation, Writing) with formal input/output contracts and checkpoint-based resumption. Integrates multi-agent debate, self-healing execution, verifiable reporting, HITL collaboration, and cross-run evolution. Treats research as iterative cycle rather than one-off process.
